headline: SpiceJet website suffers technical glitch, shifting airports to manual check-in

modes.bear: Repeated technical failures damage customer trust, increase operating friction, and drive passengers toward competing airlines.
modes.bull: Technical glitches are temporary and usually resolved quickly without causing lasting damage to the airline's long-term flight schedule.
modes.simple: SpiceJet's website broke down, meaning staff had to check in passengers by hand at airports. This can cause long lines and frustration for travelers.

summary: Budget carrier SpiceJet faced a technical glitch on its website, forcing the airline to switch to manual check-in procedures across airports. Passengers experienced delays and processing bottlenecks as online booking and ticketing systems became temporarily unavailable. For Indian retail investors, operational disruptions at airlines pose risks to near-term passenger traffic revenue and customer retention. Such technical failures can elevate cost pressures and harm brand reputation in a highly competitive aviation market.
why_it_matters: Operational glitches threaten airline revenue and passenger loyalty.
